title: Document Review — Create a Review Job
purpose: Get compliance documents (CPC, GCC, DoC, test reports, TCF) reviewed by a lab or by yourself, whether you upload them or your supplier does.
meta: https://qmas.icw.io/document-review → **Create Job** or **Create Job for supplier**
overview: Choose the flow that fits (table below).
Fill in **Job Type**, **Product Information** and the documents to review.
For a supplier job, choose the **connected supplier** who will upload.
Choose a **partner** (optional) and the **Service Provider**: a connected lab, or **Job Owner Review** to review yourself.
Click **Confirm**. Follow the status on the Document Review list until the review is concluded.

table: B. Supplier uploads for lab review
C. Supplier uploads for your own review

body: In the left menu, open **Document Review**. The dashboard shows service providers, jobs over 12 months, status and reject reasons. The tabs **All Job**, **My Job** and **View Only** list the jobs.

body.caption: Document Review with Create Job and Create Job for supplier.

body: Choose the **Job Type** (for example Document Review) and tick **CPC/GCC/DOC Review** and/or **Compliance Review**. Optionally fill in **Buyer Name**, **Service Required** (Regular by default) and **Submission Remark**.

body.caption: Create Job — 1. Job Type and 2. Product Information.

body: Keep **Select Product For Review = Yes**. Click **Existing Product** to pick products, or **New Product** to create one. For each product, check the **Basic Information**, then fill in **Additional Information**: Test Age Grade, Label Age Grade, Export Market and Country Of Origin are required.

body.caption: Basic Information and Additional Information for the selected product.

body: Below that you can add **PO Information**, upload **Product Pictures & Reference Documents**, set the **TCF Requests** (choose document types or import a TCF template) and add **Quality Requirements**.

steps.h: 4. Documents for Review, partner and provider (Flow A)
body: Under **Documents for Review**, click **Upload files** (at least one file is required). The reviewer gives a conclusion only on documents in this section.
**Select Partner** (optional): choose Yes to let one partner view the job.
**Service Provider**: choose the connected lab under **Connected Provider**. Click **Confirm**.

body.caption: Documents for Review, Select Partner and Service Provider.

steps.h: 5. Create Job for supplier (Flows B and C)
body: Click **Create Job for supplier**. Fill in Job Type and Product Information as above. Then:

list: **Select Connected Supplier**: choose the supplier who will upload. Only suppliers connected with you on QMAS are listed. See Supplier Management → Invite Supplier.
**Service Provider**: choose **Connected Provider** and a lab for Flow B, or **Job Owner Review** for Flow C.
Click **Confirm**. The supplier gets a notification to upload the documents.

body.caption: Select Connected Supplier, Select Partner and Service Provider (Connected Provider or Job Owner Review).

list: Flow A and B: the job shows **Being Processed** while the lab reviews. The lab concludes each document as **Approve**, **Reject** or **Waiting for Additional Information**.

Flow C: when the supplier has uploaded, open the job, click **View detail**, and conclude each document yourself with **Approve**, **Reject**, **N/A** or **Waiting for additional information**. Click **Confirm**.
If a document is rejected or more information is needed, read the comment and upload a corrected file.
When all documents are approved, complete the job.

tips: Flows B and C need a connected supplier. Invite the supplier first from Supplier / Factory Management → Invite Supplier.
Save a TCF document-type list as a template so you can reuse it in the next job.
faq: How do I send documents to a lab for review?

Go to Document Review (https://qmas.icw.io/document-review), click Create Job, fill in Job Type and Product Information, upload files under Documents for Review, choose the lab under Service Provider, and click Confirm.
How do I ask my supplier to upload documents for review?
Click Create Job for supplier on Document Review, choose the connected supplier, then choose Connected Provider (lab review) or Job Owner Review (you review) and click Confirm.
What does Job Owner Review mean?
You review the supplier's documents yourself instead of a lab.
Why can't I find my supplier in Select Connected Supplier?
Only suppliers connected with you on QMAS are listed. Invite them from Supplier / Factory Management → Invite Supplier.
